subject: Pricing & commitment follow-up — NovusAI / Redwood
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@novusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing & commitment follow-up — NovusAI / Redwood

Hi Samir — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: 

Recap:
- Primary use case: real-time summarization + search reranking for support tickets (low latency critical).
- Expected steady-state tokens: ~6–9M tokens/month, with peak months up to ~15M tokens.
- Target latency SLO: 150–250ms median for generate calls; embeddings for search at sub-100ms.
- Security: VPC + SOC2 is required; you mentioned procurement will want evidence and SLAs.

Pricing / budget signals you gave on the call:
- Budget range: $50k–$90k/month (you noted flexibility if unit economics scale).
- Goal unit economics: target cost approximately $300–$350 per 1M tokens (target $/1M tokens).

Questions / asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm an expected monthly token forecast (baseline and peak) for Q4 and the first 12 months so we can model committed tiers?
2) Who is the procurement/proc contact (for redlines/SOW)? You mentioned Janelle might own this — can you confirm?
3) Any legal/compliance must-haves we should pre-seed into the SOW (retention, audit window, encryption keys)?

What we can do on our side quickly:
- Provide a committed-use pricing proposal (12-month and 24-month tiers) with unit price per 1M tokens and multi-year incentives.
- Outline a startup program / credits if NovusAI qualifies (we have a standard startup package that can offset cost in the first 3–6 months).
- Share a short draft SOW and term summary for procurement review.

Next steps: if you can share the forecast and procurement contact, I’ll pull together a draft committed pricing sheet and propose 2–3 commercial options (month-to-month, 12-month commit, 24-month commit with larger discount).

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: none in this message
From: Samir Shah <samir@novusai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Janelle Morris <janelle.morris@novusai.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & commitment follow-up — NovusAI / Redwood

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the clear next steps. Confirming details from our side: 

Forecast (high-level):
- Month 1–3 (pilot): 2–4M tokens/month
- Month 4–12 (ramp): 6–9M tokens/month
- Peak/backlog months: up to 15M tokens (support surge processing)

Budget constraints: we’re targeting $60k–$80k/month initially. We can stretch if the committed pricing hits the unit targets you called out.

Startup program: NovusAI is an early-stage company (Series A) but with revenue — happy to apply. We’d love to see what credits or ramp incentives you can offer (3–6 months preferred).

Procurement: Janelle Morris (cc’d) is our Head of Procurement — she’ll handle SOW and T&Cs. Janelle, looping you in: I’d appreciate a quick read on whether NovusAI can do a 12-month committed spend (we’re leaning that way if the unit economics make sense).

I’ve attached a simple monthly forecast file to help with pricing modeling (NovusAI_usage_forecast.xlsx).

Thanks — Samir

Attachment: NovusAI_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Pricing & commitment follow-up — NovusAI / Redwood

Marissa / Neha — quick commercial note based on Samir’s forecast and target unit economics. Draft we can send to prospect: 

Option A — Pay-as-you-go (no commit)
- List price: $600 per 1M tokens (public hosted API rate for this model class)
- No minimum; suitable for pilot months.

Option B — 12-month committed usage (recommended)
- Committed baseline: 6M tokens/month (billed monthly)
- Unit price: $320 per 1M tokens (approx 47% off list in exchange for commit)
- Overage price: $420 per 1M tokens for usage above committed baseline (to preserve economics)
- Effective monthly cost at expected 8M tokens: $320*6 + $420*2 = $2,880 + $840 = $3,720 -> implies ~$465 per 1M tokens effective (note: math shows sensitivity; we'll show both baseline-effective and blended).

Option C — 24-month multi-year (best for unit economics)
- Committed baseline: 6M tokens/month
- Unit price year 1: $300 per 1M tokens
- Unit price year 2: $280 per 1M tokens
- Additional multi-year incentive: one-time implementation credit or 10% additional discount on year 1 invoice if signed within 30 days.

Startup program (early-stage credit)
- If Samir confirms Series A and qualifies, offer $30k in credits applied over first 3 months or equivalent 50% off for the first 2 months for up to a 3M token baseline. 

Notes / rationale:
- Target $/1M token goal Samir cited (~$300–$350) is achievable with a 12–24 month commit; we should lead with 12mo commit + startup credit to get them comfortable.
- Need legal to review procurement redlines (Janelle).

If you want, I can draft a short commercial term sheet (1 pager) showing effective blended costs at 6/8/10M tokens/month to make the value obvious.

-Ben
VP Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing & commitment follow-up — NovusAI / Redwood

Samir / Janelle — appreciate the forecast and looping Janelle in. Per Ben’s internal note, proposing the following commercial options for NovusAI to review quickly: 

1) Pilot / PAYG: list-rate hosted API, flexible month-to-month (good for first 2–3 months).

2) 12-month committed tier (recommended):
- Committed baseline: 6M tokens/month
- Unit price: $320 per 1M tokens
- Overage: $420 per 1M tokens above baseline
- Startup incentive (if NovusAI qualifies): $30k credit applied over first 3 months OR 50% off the first 2 months up to a 3M token baseline.

3) 24-month multi-year:
- Committed baseline: 6M tokens/month
- Year 1 unit price: $300 per 1M tokens
- Year 2 unit price: $280 per 1M tokens
- Additional incentive: sign within 30 days and receive an implementation credit equivalent to 10% off first-year invoices.

Example blended math at expected 8M tokens/month under 12-month commit:
- Committed cost = 6 * $320 = $1,920
- Overage cost = 2 * $420 = $840
- Total = $2,760 => effective ~= $345 per 1M tokens (blended).

Next steps:
- Janelle: if procurement can approve a 12-month committed baseline, we’ll send a 1-page commercial term summary + SOW draft (attached).
- Samir: confirm which startup incentive you prefer, and whether NovusAI can formalize the 12-month baseline of 6M tokens/month.

I’m attaching a short term summary and a first-pass SOW to speed review. If helpful, we can also schedule a 15–20 minute alignment with legal/proc (Janelle + our legal) this week.

Attachments: Redwood_Dedicated_Term_Summary.pdf; NovusAI_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf

Best,
